meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 通过 Chat SDK 接入 Linear:它参与 issue 评论线程,任何一条 issue 评论都会触发它回复,不需要 @提及;每个 issue 的评论线程是各自独立的会话。
howto.when: 当被监控团队(由 LINEAR_TEAM_KEY 指定)的 Linear issue 有新评论时触发,无需 @提及;也可在 /setup 流程中应用本技能。

say.text: 帮我装好 Linear 频道,用 OAuth 应用让机器人以应用身份发评论。
把 linear:ENG 这个团队接到我的 agent 分组上。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude joins Linear issue comment threads through the Chat SDK: every comment on a Linear issue triggers it to reply, with no @-mention needed, and each issue comment thread becomes its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new comment lands on an issue in the watched Linear team (set by LINEAR_TEAM_KEY), with no @-mention required; it can also be applied during the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Install the Linear channel with an OAuth app so the bot posts as an app.
I want to use a Personal API key instead — what should LINEAR_API_KEY be?
say_en.note: Answer none at both OAuth prompts, then set it

say_en.text: Wire the linear:ENG team to my agent group.
say_en.note: Creates the messaging group and wiring via ncl
